screen15-a1.glyph: three horizontal lines of decreasing length
screen15-a1.description: three stacked lines control in the top-left corner of the toolbar
screen15-a1.accessibility_text_consulted: content_desc "Open menu" — read only to know what to tap for and watch for; not used in the verdict
screen15-a1.convention_relied_on: three stacked horizontal lines (hamburger) is an established convention for opening the app's navigation menu — my reading, confidence high
screen15-a1.initial_rationale: unlabeled, but the hamburger glyph is a widely-known convention; common-icon exemption applies pending the behavioural test
screen15-a1.deciding_evidence: same control as screen1-a1 (identical appearance, words and position in the same repeated state); tested once there and the verdict carried: tapping the hamburger opened the side navigation panel, exactly what the convention promises

screen15-a2.glyph: three vertical lines with knobs at different heights
screen15-a2.description: sliders glyph in the top-right of the Artifacts screen
screen15-a2.accessibility_text_consulted: content_desc "Choose artifacts to list" — read only to know what to tap for and watch for; not used in the verdict
screen15-a2.convention_relied_on: a sliders glyph is an established 'filter / adjust' convention — my reading, confidence medium
screen15-a2.initial_rationale: filter convention on a list screen; exemption pending the behavioural test

test_cases.confirms_if: something other than a filter opens
test_cases.observed_result: a small menu opened with 'All' (checked), 'Pinned', 'Yours', 'Shared with you'

screen15-a2.deciding_evidence: opened a list filter, matching the convention

screen15-a3.accessibility_text_consulted: content_desc "Search artifacts; Search"; talkback_label "Search artifacts Search" — read only to know what to tap for and watch for; not used in the verdict
screen15-a3.initial_rationale: explicit placeholder naming both the action and the scope
screen15-a3.deciding_evidence: the placeholder names the action and scope; no test required

screen15-a4.description: small dropdown reading 'All' with a down chevron beside the search box
screen15-a4.accessibility_text_consulted: content_desc "Filter by where artifacts were made"; talkback_label "Filter by where artifacts were made All" — read only to know what to tap for and watch for; not used in the verdict
screen15-a4.initial_rationale: 'All' names a current value but not what it filters; a second filter (the sliders glyph) sits just above, so the two are indistinguishable

test_cases.action: open the 'All' dropdown, then open the sliders menu, and compare
test_cases.expected_result: if 'All' conveyed its purpose, its options would be predictable and distinct
test_cases.confirms_if: the options are not predictable from 'All' and both menus start with 'All'
test_cases.overturns_if: the dropdown's scope is predictable from its face
test_cases.observed_result: the dropdown offered All / Chat / Code (where the artifact was made); the sliders menu offered All / Pinned / Yours / Shared with you — both open on 'All' and nothing on the dropdown's face says it is about where artifacts were made

screen15-a4.deciding_evidence: the dropdown's face shows only a value; its scope is revealed only after opening and it is not distinguishable from the neighbouring filter
screen15-a4.recommendation: label the dropdown's scope, e.g. 'Made in: All ▾'
